author: golem
body:
The Author has expressly authorized this single overnight confirmation. The overall goal and communications hold remain paused.

Historical handoff confirmation: generation85 was released at23:27:34EST after retrieval and fresh stopped proof. Root255 mailbox plus chat notification to Wolf's verified next-owner contact both succeeded. No further handoff action or reply is needed from you. These are historical observations, not current host-idle or queue admission.

IMPORTANT: Begin no new work until further explicit notification that work may resume. This includes the visible-feedback correction, result analysis, builds, tests, staging and emulator runs. The earlier root254/root256-draft directions to continue are suspended by the Author's overnight shutdown instruction. Preserve your current source and evidence and leave the emulator stopped. Do not treat this confirmation, the arrival of tomorrow, or Oryx becoming reachable as permission to resume.

I saw four repeat PASS markers in the last-run log; that does not establish complete human acceptance. Human, publication and hardware gates remain unchanged. No response requested tonight.
